description: This Java class 'HibernateObsDAO' provides Hibernate-specific implementations of data access methods for observation ('Obs') entities in the OpenMRS medical record system. It handles CRUD operations, complex queries, and retrieval of 'Obs' objects based on various criteria such as person, encounter, concepts, date ranges, and more.

classes.name: HibernateObsDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of the ObsDAO interface, providing database operations for 'Obs' entities using Hibernate ORM.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory to establish database connection.

methods.name: deleteObs
methods.description: Deletes an 'Obs' record from the database.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves an 'Obs' entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves or updates an 'Obs' entity, handling group members if present.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of 'Obs' entities based on various filtering criteria such as person, encounter, concepts, date range, etc.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Returns the count of 'Obs' entities matching specified criteria.

methods.name: getRevisionObs
methods.description: Fetches the previous version of a given 'Obs', if any.

methods.name: getSavedStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the save status of an 'Obs' record directly via SQL query.
